shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large stone slab
bird head in profile with prominent hooked/pointed beak
horizontal band of repeated small marks running across the top
animal or creature figures in profile
division of the surface into upper band and main figural field
justification: Both are tan stone slabs organised with a horizontal band of small repeated marks along the top edge above a main field in which profile bird-headed creatures appear alongside branch/plant motifs, which is a reasonably specific structural echo. The difference is decisive in execution and density: A is shallow, sparse and schematic with isolated outline figures floating on blank ground, while B is a crowded, deeply modelled and minutely detailed composition with a single dominant standing figure and dense, regular floral filling.
